second_pass.result: No additional finding. The public variant names the shipped surface ('Trung tâm tác nhân') and the organisation variant names the recipient, so the two cannot be confused; the receipt forms use 'Đã …' with no question mark while the questions keep '?'; the ask paragraph states what an agent is and what the box does, in that order.

rulings.question: is 'đến {destination}' natural for publishing to an organisation, or should it be 'lên'?
rulings.ruling: accepted; 'lên' would be the platform preposition and wrong for an org

rulings.question: 'cập nhật {when}' with an age phrase that already ends in 'trước'

findings.observation: RULING (asked): 'trực tiếp' is accepted; it is not an embellishment of the English. The product's own shipped sentence for this capability carries 'directly' in English and 'trực tiếp' in Vietnamese, and the paragraph reuses that sentence's two clauses.
findings.evidence: en ui.agents.detail.kind.role = 'You can chat with it directly'; shipped vi ui.agents.detail.kind.role = 'Bạn có thể trò chuyện trực tiếp với nó'; shipped vi ui.agents.detail.kind.specialist = 'Các tác nhân khác có thể gọi đến nó'. 'trực tiếp với nó' reads as direct conversation with the agent, not the 'live/in person' sense.

findings.observation: RULING (asked): 'Tự thêm' is accepted for 'manually' / 'by hand'. The locale's 'thủ công' marks manual operation instead of automation, which is a different contrast from this button (make it yourself instead of asking in words).
findings.evidence: shipped vi ui.agents.pages.empty.agents and empty.teams already render 'Ask for one below, or add one by hand' as 'Hãy yêu cầu bên dưới hoặc tự thêm.'. All 4 shipped 'thủ công' strings contrast with automation (actions.copy_failed, updates.update_notification.the_server_needs_updating_by_hand, subscriptions.subscribe_description, subscriptions.manual_available). 16 cells also fits the 288 px ghost button better than the 22-cell 'Thêm tác nhân thủ công'.

findings.observation: RULING: 'Yêu cầu một tác nhân' / 'Yêu cầu một nhóm' use the verb this pane already ships for the action, stay at three Vietnamese words, and stay headings rather than sentences.
findings.evidence: shipped vi ui.agents.pages.empty.agents/teams ('Hãy yêu cầu bên dưới…'), ui.agents.config.composer.label ('Yêu cầu thay đổi tác nhân hoặc nhóm'). The sibling pair differs only in its object, as its sidecar requires.

findings.current: Tác nhân là một bộ chỉ dẫn tái sử dụng: bạn có thể trò chuyện trực tiếp với nó, hoặc để tác nhân khác gọi đến. Mô tả điều bạn muốn và một lần chạy cấu hình sẽ thiết lập nó.
findings.problem: The second clause elides the object pronoun ('để tác nhân khác gọi đến') where the shipped sibling keeps it ('Các tác nhân khác có thể gọi đến nó'). It is grammatical here because the preceding 'với nó' supplies the referent and no reader is misled; only the parallelism with the shipped sentence is lost.
findings.proposed: …hoặc để tác nhân khác gọi đến nó. No slot budget is affected (the paragraph wraps at the 810 px measure); optional polish, not gating.

findings.observation: Placeholders fit their slots: docked 38 cells vs the English 44, hero 20 vs 23, about 16 vs 14 around a data name that can be long. Nothing was lengthened, so no new wrap or clip is introduced: the docked box's own sidecar records that the 44-character English already wraps readably (301.1709 px unwrapped in a 304 px content area, scrollHeight == clientHeight == 55).

findings.observation: RULING (asked): 'Ủy quyền' is accepted as the Delegates fact. Vietnamese does not inflect, so the noun gloss is shared with the delegation section; in the dot-separated fact line it reads as the capability, not as a command, and it is deliberately shorter than the editable switch's full sentence.
findings.evidence: shipped vi ui.agents.detail.delegate.label and delegate.aria = 'Có thể ủy quyền cho tác nhân con'; detail.section.delegation = 'Ủy quyền và cấp năng lực'. The meta line renders sourceLabel + this key + a hard-coded 'Specialist' (src/renderer/src/features/agents/components/agent-detail.tsx:170-176), so the key lands in a translated sentence slot as a bare fact. Spelling 'ủy' (tone on the first vowel, NFC) is the guide's wave-2 call.

findings.observation: The expander pair is clearly opposed and terse: 'Hiện tất cả' / 'Thu gọn'. 'Hiện tất cả' matches the shipped short form for showing everything; 'Thu gọn' is the shipped collapse verb.
findings.evidence: shipped vi ui.browser.browser_surface.show_all_tabs = 'Hiện tất cả tab'; ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.collapse_sidebar = 'Thu gọn thanh bên'; ui.settings.configuration…collapse_all = 'Thu gọn tất cả'. Widths are 11 and 7 cells against an 8- and 9-character English pair; the sidecar's '48x17.4 px box measured at native' is read as the measured box of the English label itself, since a fixed 48 px clamp would also cut 'Show less'. The hint's own rule ('one short word or two') is met; if QA finds the box is a fixed 48 px clamp rather than measured text, the 11-cell 'Hiện tất cả' becomes a fit question.

findings.observation: Out-of-audit observation (not a finding against this change): in the same metadata line the 'Specialist' fact is a hard-coded English literal, so the vi line reads 'Nguồn · Ủy quyền · Specialist' - the very concept this repository translates as 'Chuyên gia' in ui.hub.teams.kind.specialist. findings.observation: RULING (asked): 'đến {destination}' is natural and correct for publishing to an organisation, and the contrast with the public variant's 'lên' is the right one.
